  SPECIAL MEETING
  NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE INGLEWOOD SUCCESSOR AGENCY
  (Government Code Section 54956)

  TO THE MEMBERS OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL/
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY/HOUSING AUTHORITY/PARKING AUTHORITY
NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor/Chairman that a special meeting of the City
Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Parking Authority will be held on Tuesday, January 25,
2022, at 3:30 p.m., in the Council Chambers, One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, California
(Government Code Section 54956)
  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****
  COVID-19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS
Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and
pursuant to Assembly Bill 361, please note that members of the public will be allowed only to observe and address
the Successor Agency Meeting of Tuesday, January 25, 2022, 3:30 p.m. by telephone, video and other electronic
means, as follows:

  1. Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for
  consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance
  Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City
  Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org.
  To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, City Clerk
  staff will check and print emails prior to arriving in the Council Chambers. In the body of the email, please
  identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda
  item. Comments received will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of
  the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

Inglewood, California
  January 25, 2022

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Tuesday,
  January 25, 2022, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and
  Parking Authority at the hour of 3:31 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/ Housing Authority Secretary/ Parking
  Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/ Successor Agency Chairman/ Housing Authority
  Chairman/ Parking Authority Chairman Butts, Council
  Members/Successor  Agency  Members/  Housing
  Authority Members/ Parking Authority Members Padilla,
  and Faulk; and
  Absent:  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/ Housing
  Authority Members/Parking Authority Members Dotson,
  and Morales.
  City officials and personnel present were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Louis Atwell  Assistant City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Parking
  Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS. Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/ Housing Authority
  Chairman/ Parking Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Parking
  Authority on any item on the Agendas.

  There was no response.

125  AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO AGREEMENT NO. 20-217 APPROVED – REMY
  MOOSE MANLEY, LLP; PAYMENT OF OUTSTANDING INVOICE
  AUTHORIZED – REMY MOOSE MANLEY, LLP; RESOLUTION NO. 22-46
  ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2021-2022 ANNUAL BUDGET.
  Staff report dated January 25, 2022, was presented recommending approval of
  Amendment No. 2 to Agreement No. 20-217 with Remy Moose Manley, LLP (Special
  Counsel), expanding the scope of services and increasing the hourly rates.

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Amendment No. 2 to Agreement No. 20-217
  increasing the total compensation from $275,000 to 550,000; 2) Authorize payment of an
  outstanding invoice in the amount of $44,282; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 22-46
  entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 BUDGET

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.
   January 25, 2022

142  AGREEMENT NO. 22-125 APPROVED – MGT OF AMERICA CONSULTING,
  LLC; PAYMENT OF INVOICES AUTHORIZED – TRANSPORTATION
  IMPACT FEE STUDY; RESOLUTION NO. 22-47 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE
  FISCAL YEAR 2021-2022 BUDGET. Staff report dated January 25, 2022, was
  presented recommending approval of a three (3)-year Professional Services Agreement
  with MGT of America Consulting, LLC (with an option to extend an additional two years
  in one-year increments), to perform annual updated Full Cost Allocation Plan and User
  Fee Study and updates.

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that the City
  Council does hereby: 1) Approve Professional Services Agreement No. 22-125 in a total
  amount not to exceed $360,500; 2) Authorize payment for invoices, totaling $10,027.80,
  for work performed on the Transportation Impact Fee study; and 3) Adopt Resolution No.
  22-47 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2021-2022 BUDGET

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

142  RESOLUTION NO. 22-48 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2021-
  2022 ANNUAL BUDGET TO ROLL PRIOR YEAR ENCUMBRANCES INTO
  THE CURRENT FISCAL YEAR. Staff report dated January 25, 2022, was presented
  recommending adoption of a resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2021-2022 Annual
  Budget to roll prior year encumbrances into the current fiscal year.

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  Resolution No. 22-48 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE 2021-2022 ANNUAL BUDGET TO ROLL
  PRIOR YEAR ENCUMBRANCES INTO THE CURRENT FISCAL YEAR

  be adopted. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

183  CONTRACT AWARDED AND AGREEMENT NO. 22-126 APPROVED –
  OMEGA EVENTS, INC. Staff report dated January 25, 2022, was presented
  recommending award of a contract and approval of an agreement with Omega Events,
  Inc., for Stage and Equipment for 3-Day Pre-Big Game Concert Series Event, per
  Request for Proposal (RFP-0176).

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby award contract and approve Agreement No. 22-126 in an
  amount not to exceed $108,139.10 (includes a fifteen percent (15%) contingency in an
  amount not to exceed $14,105.10). The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

183  AGREEMENT NO. 22-127 APPROVED – NATIONAL FOOTBALL LEAGUE
  (NFL). Staff report dated January 25, 2022, was presented recommending the execution
  of a Parking Lot Lease Agreement (Lease Agreement) with the National Football League
  (NFL) to provide temporary parking and staging uses by the NFL on certain City of
  Inglewood-owned real property (Civic Lot) located at the south-east corner of South

  2
   January 25, 2022

  Prairie Avenue at E. Arbor Vitae Street from January 31, 2022, through February 12,
  2022.

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby execute and enter into Parking Lot Agreement No. 22-127.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

125  AGREEMENT NOS. 22-108/22-108A/22-108B/22-108D APPROVED – KANE,
  BALLMER & BERKMAN (“SPECIAL COUNSEL”). Staff report dated January 25,
  2022, was presented recommending approval of an agreement with Kane, Ballmer &
  Berkman (“Special Counsel”) for legal advice, guidance, and representation.

  It was moved by Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority
  Member/Parking Authority Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member/Parking Authority Member
  Faulk that the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Parking Authority does
  hereby: 1) Approve Agreement Nos. 22-108/22-108A/22-108B/22-108D in the total
  amount of $700,000; and 2) Authorize payment of outstanding invoices for Special
  Counsel’s legal services relating to Murphy’s Bowl in an amount not to exceed $301,000;
  and 3) Authorize payment of outstanding invoices for Special Counsel’s legal services
  relating to the City, Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Parking Authority in an
  amount not to exceed $72,000. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/ Housing Authority Members/
  Parking Authority Members Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor/ Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/ Parking Authority Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members/ Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority
  Members/Parking Authority Members Dotson, and Morales.

183  CONTRACT AWARDED AND AGREEMENT NO. 22-129 APPROVED – ANSER
  ADVISORY, LLC; MAYOR AUTHORIZED – EXECUTION OF THE
  AGREEMENT FOR PROJECT ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT SERVICES FOR
  THE INGLEWOOD TRANSIT CONNECTOR PROJECT; RESOLUTION NO.
  22-49 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2021-2022 ANNUAL
  BUDGET. Staff report dated January 25, 2022, was presented recommending award of a
  contract and approval of an agreement with Anser Advisory, LLC to provide Project
  Administrative Support Services (On-Call) for the Inglewood Transit Connector (ITC),
  per Request for Proposal No. RFP-0173.

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Award contract and approve Agreement No. 22-129 in
  the amount of $2,000,000; 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute Agreement No. 22-129 for
  Project Administrative Support Services for the Inglewood Transit Connector Project;
  and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 22-49 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 BUDGET

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in memory of Earnie Scott, nephew of Council Member Dotson, at the hour of
  3:34 p.m.

 January 25, 2022
